title: Transit funding agreement and write-off of uncollectible accounts
subtitle: Regional workforce strategy, hybrid work, and a request for a policy on councillors' external support staff
overview: The Administration and Finance Committee recommended that the Region enter into a Transfer Payment Agreement with the Province of Ontario for Phase 4 of the Safe Restart Agreement Transit Stream. The committee also recommended writing off $169,481.50 in uncollectible accounts for 2022. Both go to Council for final adoption.

Staff explained that the write-offs cover individual accounts over $10,000, mostly related to housing, with one general receivable. Smaller accounts are written off under staff authority set by by-law. Staff said the amount is small compared with the total billed during the year.

The committee received a staff presentation on sustaining a strong workforce. It heard that high inflation and low unemployment make hiring and retention harder. About a third of staff work in a hybrid model, with a minimum of two days a week in a Regional office. The committee also directed staff to report back on a policy for councillors hiring external support staff, including communications parameters and comparisons with similar municipalities.

decisions.item: Safe Restart Agreement Transit Stream Phase 4
decisions.detail: The committee recommended that the Regional Chair and Clerk enter into a Transfer Payment Agreement with the Province of Ontario, to the satisfaction of the Regional Solicitor and Chief Financial Officer {{vote:m3}}.
The committee recommended writing off $169,481.50 in accounts receivable for the year ended December 31, 2022 {{vote:m4}}.
